title: reckon-email-message
description: What reckon keeps about an email message that STIX has no property for: its thread id, its envelope recipients, and the recipients that are not addresses.

thread_uid.description: The id of the email thread the message is part of, as the source gives it.

envelope_to_refs.description: The envelope recipients: the SMTP RCPT TO and Delivered-To addresses.

unparsed_recipients.description: Each recipient the record gives that is still not an email address after cleanup, as text, sorted.
